title: [review] lora_ipv6_mesh-mkk4: build artifacts committed in rust/target/
description:
Commit d83cbc5 includes 3 files under `rust/target/`:
- `rust/target/debug/deps/lichen_gateway-f1ce66f1c4497e73.d` — host-specific dep file with absolute paths
- `rust/target/debug/incremental/lichen_gateway-22bf9b6an4f75/s-hkp20uavb7-14gy7hh-working/dep-graph.part.bin` — binary incremental build artifact (4.2 MB)
- `rust/target/debug/incremental/lichen_gateway-22bf9b6an4f75/s-hkp20uavb7-14gy7hh.lock` — incremental build lock file

Root cause: the root `.gitignore` does not exclude `target/`. Only `firmware/bridge-rust/.gitignore` has `target/`. These build artifacts are now tracked in git, polluting the repo with host-specific paths and binary blobs.

Fix: add `target/` to the root `.gitignore`, then `git rm --cached` the tracked artifacts.
